meta.name: UPN Sitcoms: Girlfriends, The Parkers
meta.description:
After 20 years, UPN is back. Revisit the sitcoms that made you laugh with the stars you loved from the network you've missed. And you can only watch it here on Pluto TV.

Shows: Girlfriends, The Parkers, One On One, Malcolm & Eddie, Everybody Hates Chris
Available on: Pluto TV
